This '''man''' was the father of the famous [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. His [[Kenobi family/Legends|family]] also included his [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's mother/Legends|wife]] and a son who Obi-Wan believed to be his brother due to force visions, [[Owen (Kenobi)|Owen]], however it turns out that [[Owen (Kenobi)|Owen]] was actually [[Owen Lars]], [[Luke Skywalker]]'s uncle.

==Behind the scenes==
Obi-Wan Kenobi's father was first seen in a flashback in ''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Hidden Past]]'', the third book of the young readers series [[Star Wars: Jedi Apprentice|''Jedi Apprentice'']], written by [[Jude Watson]].
